She has long, wavy blonde hair with subtle honey highlights, styled in a messy half-up high pony or playful pigtails, with loose face-framing strands and a slightly tousled look. Her face is heart-shaped to oval with almond-shaped blue-green eyes, winged eyeliner, natural groomed brows, a small button nose, full glossy pink lips, and rosy flushed cheeks with heavy blush for a youthful glow. She is wearing a two-piece string bikini in neon magenta (hot pink) and bright turquoise/seafoam green, featuring a green lace or patterned overlay with solid neon pink trim and straps. The top is a triangle halter style and the bottoms are low-rise side-tie strings. Accessories include a beaded choker necklace with white, turquoise, and metallic beads, an anklet on her left ankle, and platform slides/sandals visible in one frame. Panel poses: Top left: full body, leaning back against a wall with one leg bent and lifted, left hand making a shaka sign, winking with a slight smile and tongue lightly pressing teeth. Top right: waist-up, facing forward, holding the ends of her hair outward, making a duck-face pout and looking to the side. Bottom left: full body, legs shoulder-width and knees slightly bent, double peace signs near her eyes, playful pout/kiss face with eyes closed or squinting. Bottom right: waist-up, arms raised with hands resting on her head, soft gaze at the camera, mouth slightly open with a relaxed, alluring expression. The setting is an indoor stairwell or hallway landing with plain light blue-grey or cool mint walls, a white dual light switch plate, a white painted wooden handrail on the right, beige/light grey carpet, and white baseboards. Lighting is bright on-camera flash creating sharp shadows and high contrast, like indoor artificial flash photography.
